title: त्रयोदशोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 13 · Krishna counsels: Jarasandha must fall

summary.en: Krishna tells Yudhishthira he is worthy of the Rajasuya, but that Jarasandha of Magadha, who has imprisoned eighty-six kings to sacrifice them and once drove the Yadavas from Mathura, must first be overcome. While Jarasandha lives, no one can be emperor.
summary.kn: ರಾಜಸೂಯಕ್ಕೆ ನೀನು ಯೋಗ್ಯನೆಂದು ಶ್ರೀಕೃಷ್ಣನು ಹೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಆದರೆ ಬಲಿಕೊಡಲು ಎಂಬತ್ತಾರು ರಾಜರನ್ನು ಸೆರೆಯಲ್ಲಿಟ್ಟು ಹಿಂದೆ ಯಾದವರನ್ನು ಮಥುರೆಯಿಂದ ಓಡಿಸಿದ ಮಗಧದ ಜರಾಸಂಧನನ್ನು ಮೊದಲು ಜಯಿಸಬೇಕು. ಅವನು ಬದುಕಿರುವವರೆಗೆ ಯಾರೂ ಸಮ್ರಾಟನಾಗಲಾರನು.
summary.hi: श्रीकृष्ण युधिष्ठिर से कहते हैं कि वे राजसूय के योग्य हैं, पर पहले मगध के जरासन्ध को जीतना होगा, जिसने बलि के लिए छियासी राजाओं को बन्दी बना रखा है और कभी यादवों को मथुरा से भगाया था। जरासन्ध के जीवित रहते कोई सम्राट नहीं हो सकता।
summary.te: రాజసూయానికి నీవు అర్హుడవని శ్రీకృష్ణుడు చెబుతాడు; కానీ బలి ఇవ్వడానికి ఎనభై ఆరుగురు రాజులను చెరసాలలో ఉంచి, ఒకప్పుడు యాదవులను మథుర నుండి తరిమిన మగధ జరాసంధుని ముందుగా జయించాలి. అతడు జీవించి ఉండగా ఎవరూ సామ్రాట్టు కాలేరు.
summary.ta: ராஜஸூயத்துக்கு நீர் தகுதியானவர் என்று ஸ்ரீகிருஷ்ணர் சொல்கிறார்; ஆனால் பலியிட எண்பத்தாறு மன்னர்களைச் சிறையிலடைத்து, முன்பு யாதவர்களை மதுரையிலிருந்து விரட்டிய மகத ஜராஸந்தனை முதலில் வெல்ல வேண்டும். அவன் உயிருடன் இருக்கும் வரை எவரும் சக்கரவர்த்தியாக முடியாது.
summary.ml: യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ രാജസൂയത്തിന് യോഗ്യനാണെന്ന് കൃഷ്ണൻ പറയുന്നു; എന്നാൽ എൺപത്തിയാറു രാജാക്കന്മാരെ ബലിയർപ്പിക്കാൻ തടവിലാക്കിയതും, ഒരിക്കൽ മഥുരയിൽ നിന്ന് യാദവരെ ഓടിച്ചതുമായ മഗധരാജാവ് ജരാസന്ധനെ ആദ്യം കീഴടക്കണമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പറയുന്നു. ജരാസന്ധൻ ജീവിച്ചിരിക്കുന്നിടത്തോളം ആർക്കും ചക്രവർത്തിയാകാനാവില്ല.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 2.13; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Wed Apr 19 2006

verses.text: श्रीकृष्ण उवाच

meaning.en: Shri Krishna said:

verses.text:
सर्वैर्गुणैर्महाराज राजसूयं त्वमर्हसि ।
जानतस्त्वेव ते सर्वं किंचिद्वक्ष्यामि भारत ॥

meaning.en: Great king, you are fit for the Rajasuya in every quality; though you know all this, Bharata, I will say something.

verses.text:
जामदग्न्येन रामेण क्षत्रं यदवशेषितम् ।
तस्मादवरजं लोके यदिदं क्षत्रसंज्ञितम् ॥

meaning.en: After Rama, son of Jamadagni, destroyed the Kshatriyas, those who remained and are now called Kshatriyas in the world are of a later and lesser stock.

verses.text:
कृतोऽयं कुलसंकल्पः क्षत्रियैर्वसुधाधिप ।
निदेशवाग्भिस्तत्ते ह विदितं भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: This arrangement of the families was made by the Kshatriyas themselves, lord of the earth, through words of agreement, as you know, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
ऐलस्येक्ष्वाकुवंशस्य प्रकृतिं परिचक्षते ।
राजानः श्रेणिबद्धाश्च ततोऽन्ये क्षत्रिया भुवि ॥

meaning.en: They say the root of the kings is the line of Aila and that of Ikshvaku; the ranked kings and the other Kshatriyas on earth come after them.

verses.text:
ऐलवंश्यास्तु ये राजंस्तथैवेक्ष्वाकवो नृपाः ।
तानि चैकशतं विद्धि कुलानि भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: The kings of Aila's line and the Ikshvaku kings, bull of the Bharatas, know them to number a hundred and one families.

verses.text:
ययातेस्त्वेव भोजानां विस्तरोऽतिगुणो महान् ।
भजते च महाराज विस्तरः स चतुर्दिशम् ॥

meaning.en: From Yayati, the great and excellent branch of the Bhojas spread out, great king, and that branch spreads in all four directions.

verses.text:
तेषां तथैव तां लक्ष्मीं सर्वक्षत्रमुपासते ।
सोऽवनीं मध्यमां भुक्त्वा मिथोभेदेष्वमन्यत ॥

meaning.en: All the Kshatriyas honor their fortune. Having ruled the middle of the earth, one of them took thought among their quarrels.

verses.text:
चतुर्युस्त्वपरो राजा यस्मिन्नेकशतोऽभवत् ।
स साम्राज्यं जरासंधः प्राप्तो भवति योनितः ॥

meaning.en: There is another king, Chaturyu, in whose line there came to be a hundred and one; from that stock Jarasandha has gained imperial rank.

verses.text:
तं स राजा महाप्राज्ञ संश्रित्य किल सर्वशः ।
राजन्सेनापतिर्जातः शिशुपालः प्रतापवान् ॥

meaning.en: The mighty Shishupala, wise king, relied on him altogether and became his commander.

verses.text:
तमेव च महाराज शिष्यवत्समुपस्थितः ।
वक्रः करूषाधिपतिर्मायायोधी महाबलः ॥

meaning.en: Vakra, lord of the Karushas, great in strength and a fighter by sorcery, serves that same king like a pupil, great king.

verses.text:
अपरौ च महावीर्यौ महात्मानौ समाश्रितौ ।
जरासंधं महावीर्यं तौ हंसडिभकावुभौ ॥

meaning.en: And two other mighty and great-souled warriors, Hamsa and Dibhaka, have taken refuge with the powerful Jarasandha.

verses.text:
दन्तवक्रः करूषश्च कलभो मेघवाहनः ।
मूर्ध्ना दिव्यं मणिं बिभ्रद्यं तं भूतमणिं विदुः ॥

meaning.en: Dantavakra, Karusha, Kalabha, Meghavahana, and the one who wears a heavenly gem on his head, whom they call Bhutamani.

verses.text:
मुरं च नरकं चैव शास्ति यो यवनाधिपौ ।
अपर्यन्तबलो राजा प्रतीच्यां वरुणो यथा ॥

meaning.en: And the one who rules over Mura and Naraka, the two lords of the Yavanas, a king of endless force like Varuna in the west;

verses.text:
भगदत्तो महाराज वृद्धस्तव पितुः सखा ।
स वाचा प्रणतस्तस्य कर्मणा चैव भारत ॥

meaning.en: great king, the old Bhagadatta, your father's friend, is bowed to him in word and deed.

verses.text:
स्नेहबद्धस्तु पितृवन्मनसा भक्तिमांस्त्वयि ।
प्रतीच्यां दक्षिणं चान्तं पृथिव्याः पाति यो नृपः ॥

meaning.en: But bound by affection, with the heart of a father, he is devoted to you, he who guards the western and the southern edges of the earth.

verses.text:
मातुलो भवतः शूरः पुरुजित्कुन्तिवर्धनः ।
स ते संनतिमानेकः स्नेहतः शत्रुतापनः ॥

meaning.en: Your mother's brother, the brave Purujit, who increased Kunti's family, is alone submissive to you, out of affection, tormentor of foes.

verses.text:
जरासंधं गतस्त्वेवं पुरा यो न मया हतः ।
पुरुषोत्तमविज्ञातो योऽसौ चेदिषु दुर्मतिः ॥

meaning.en: He who went over to Jarasandha so, and whom I did not kill before, the evil-minded one among the Chedis, who was recognized as best of men,

verses.text:
आत्मानं प्रतिजानाति लोकेऽस्मिन्पुरुषोत्तमम् ।
आदत्ते सततं मोहाद्यः स चिह्नं च मामकम् ॥

meaning.en: who claims in this world to be the best of men and who in folly always takes up my own marks,

verses.text:
वङ्गपुण्ड्रकिरातेषु राजा बलसमन्वितः ।
पौण्ड्रको वासुदेवेति योऽसौ लोकेषु विश्रुतः ॥

meaning.en: the king in Vanga, Pundra and Kirata lands, strong with armies, famed in the worlds as Paundraka Vasudeva;

verses.text:
चतुर्युः स महाराज भोज इन्द्रसखो बली ।
विद्याबलाद्यो व्यजयत्पाण्ड्यक्रथककैशिकान् ॥

meaning.en: and Chaturyu the Bhoja, great king, strong friend of Indra, who by his knowledge and strength defeated the Pandyas, Kratha and Kaishika,

verses.text:
भ्राता यस्याहृतिः शूरो जामदग्न्यसमो युधि ।
स भक्तो मागधं राजा भीष्मकः परवीरहा ॥

meaning.en: whose brother Ahriti is brave and the equal of Jamadagni's son in battle, and the king Bhishmaka, slayer of enemy heroes, is devoted to the king of Magadha.

verses.text:
प्रियाण्याचरतः प्रह्वान्सदा संबन्धिनः सतः ।
भजतो न भजत्यस्मानप्रियेषु व्यवस्थितः ॥

meaning.en: Though we are a good kinsman, who always does what pleases and bows to him, he does not return our regard, and stays set among those who dislike us.

verses.text:
न कुलं न बलं राजन्नभिजानंस्तथात्मनः ।
पश्यमानो यशो दीप्तं जरासंधमुपाश्रितः ॥

meaning.en: Not looking at family or at strength, seeing only his own blazing fame, he has taken refuge with Jarasandha.

verses.text:
उदीच्यभोजाश्च तथा कुलान्यष्टादशाभिभो ।
जरासंधभयादेव प्रतीचीं दिशमाश्रिताः ॥

meaning.en: Mighty one, the northern Bhojas and eighteen families, from fear of Jarasandha alone, have fled to the western region.

verses.text:
शूरसेना भद्रकारा बोधाः शाल्वाः पटच्चराः ।
सुस्थराश्च सुकुट्टाश्च कुणिन्दाः कुन्तिभिः सह ॥

meaning.en: The Shurasenas, Bhadrakaras, Bodhas, Shalvas, Patachcharas, Susthiras, Sukuttas, Kunindas and the Kuntis;

verses.text:
शाल्वेयानां च राजानः सोदर्यानुचरैः सह ।
दक्षिणा ये च पाञ्चालाः पूर्वाः कुन्तिषु कोशलाः ॥

meaning.en: the kings of the Shalveyas with their brothers and followers, the southern Panchalas, and the eastern Kosalas among the Kuntis;

verses.text:
तथोत्तरां दिशं चापि परित्यज्य भयार्दिताः ।
मत्स्याः संन्यस्तपादाश्च दक्षिणां दिशमाश्रिताः ॥

meaning.en: likewise, leaving the northern quarter in fear, the Matsyas and Sannyastapadas have taken refuge in the south.

verses.text:
तथैव सर्वपाञ्चाला जरासंधभयार्दिताः ।
स्वराष्ट्रं संपरित्यज्य विद्रुताः सर्वतोदिशम् ॥

meaning.en: So too all the Panchalas, afflicted by fear of Jarasandha, left their own country and fled in all directions.

verses.text:
कस्यचित्त्वथ कालस्य कंसो निर्मथ्य बान्धवान् ।
बार्हद्रथसुते देव्यावुपागच्छद्वृथामतिः ॥

meaning.en: After a time Kamsa, of evil mind, having crushed his own kin, took to wife the two daughters of Brihadratha's son.

verses.text:
अस्तिः प्राप्तिश्च नाम्ना ते सहदेवानुजेऽबले ।
बलेन तेन स ज्ञातीनभिभूय वृथामतिः ॥

meaning.en: Their names were Asti and Prapti, the younger sisters of Sahadeva, and they were helpless; with the strength of that marriage, evil-minded Kamsa overpowered his kinsmen.

verses.text:
श्रैष्ठ्यं प्राप्तः स तस्यासीदतीवापनयो महान् ।
भोजराजन्यवृद्धैस्तु पीड्यमानैर्दुरात्मना ॥

meaning.en: He reached chieftainship, and his misconduct was very great; the elders of the Bhoja nobles were oppressed by that wicked man.

verses.text:
ज्ञातित्राणमभीप्सद्भिरस्मत्संभावना कृता ।
दत्त्वाक्रूराय सुतनुं तामाहुकसुतां तदा ॥

meaning.en: Wishing to save their kin, they sought help from us; I gave the fair daughter of Ahuka to Akrura then.

verses.text:
संकर्षणद्वितीयेन ज्ञातिकार्यं मया कृतम् ।
हतौ कंससुनामानौ मया रामेण चाप्युत ॥

meaning.en: With Sankarshana as my second, I did the kinsmen's task: Kamsa and Sunaman were killed by me and Rama.

verses.text:
भये तु समुपक्रान्ते जरासंधे समुद्यते ।
मन्त्रोऽयं मन्त्रितो राजन्कुलैरष्टादशावरैः ॥

meaning.en: But when danger arose with Jarasandha mounting his attack, this counsel was taken, O king, by the families, down to the eighteen lesser ones.

verses.text:
अनारमन्तो निघ्नन्तो महास्त्रैः शतघातिभिः ।
न हन्याम वयं तस्य त्रिभिर्वर्षशतैर्बलम् ॥

meaning.en: "Even if we kept fighting without rest and slew his men with great weapons that kill a hundred at a time, we could not destroy his army in three hundred years."

verses.text:
तस्य ह्यमरसंकाशौ बलेन बलिनां वरौ ।
नामभ्यां हंसडिभकावित्यास्तां योधसत्तमौ ॥

meaning.en: He has two heroes like immortals, the strongest of the strong, named Hamsa and Dibhaka, the best of fighters.

verses.text:
तावुभौ सहितौ वीरौ जरासंधश्च वीर्यवान् ।
त्रयस्त्रयाणां लोकानां पर्याप्ता इति मे मतिः ॥

meaning.en: Those two heroes together and the mighty Jarasandha, I think, are enough to match all three worlds.

verses.text:
न हि केवलमस्माकं यावन्तोऽन्ये च पार्थिवाः ।
तथैव तेषामासीच्च बुद्धिर्बुद्धिमतां वर ॥

meaning.en: And not we alone, best of the wise, but all the other kings thought the same.

verses.text:
अथ हंस इति ख्यातः कश्चिदासीन्महान्नृपः ।
स चान्यैः सहितो राजन्संग्रामेऽष्टादशावरैः ॥

meaning.en: Now there was a great king known as Hamsa, who with others, down to eighteen lesser kings, was in a battle.

verses.text:
हतो हंस इति प्रोक्तमथ केनापि भारत ।
तच्छ्रुत्वा डिभको राजन्यमुनाम्भस्यमज्जत ॥

meaning.en: Someone then said, "Hamsa is dead," O Bharata; hearing this, Dibhaka plunged into the waters of the Yamuna.

verses.text:
विना हंसेन लोकेऽस्मिन्नाहं जीवितुमुत्सहे ।
इत्येतां मतिमास्थाय डिभको निधनं गतः ॥

meaning.en: "Without Hamsa I cannot bear to live in this world." Taking this resolve, Dibhaka went to his death.

verses.text:
तथा तु डिभकं श्रुत्वा हंसः परपुरंजयः ।
प्रपेदे यमुनामेव सोऽपि तस्यां न्यमज्जत ॥

meaning.en: Hearing of Dibhaka's death, Hamsa, conqueror of enemy cities, went to the Yamuna itself and drowned in it too.

verses.text:
तौ स राजा जरासंधः श्रुत्वाप्सु निधनं गतौ ।
स्वपुरं शूरसेनानां प्रययौ भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: Hearing that the two had died in the water, King Jarasandha went back to his own city of the Shurasenas, bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
ततो वयममित्रघ्न तस्मिन्प्रतिगते नृपे ।
पुनरानन्दिताः सर्वे मथुरायां वसामहे ॥

meaning.en: Then, slayer of enemies, after that king had gone back, we all lived happy again in Mathura.

verses.text:
यदा त्वभ्येत्य पितरं सा वै राजीवलोचना ।
कंसभार्या जरासंधं दुहिता मागधं नृपम् ॥

meaning.en: But when Kamsa's lotus-eyed wife, his wife and Jarasandha's daughter, came to her father, the king of Magadha,

verses.text:
चोदयत्येव राजेन्द्र पतिव्यसनदुःखिता ।
पतिघ्नं मे जहीत्येवं पुनः पुनररिंदम ॥

meaning.en: grieving over her husband's ruin, she kept urging him, O king of kings, again and again, "Kill the slayer of my husband."

verses.text:
ततो वयं महाराज तं मन्त्रं पूर्वमन्त्रितम् ।
संस्मरन्तो विमनसो व्यपयाता नराधिप ॥

meaning.en: Then, great king, remembering the counsel taken earlier, we left in low spirits, O lord of men.

verses.text:
पृथक्त्वेन द्रुता राजन्संक्षिप्य महतीं श्रियम् ।
प्रपतामो भयात्तस्य सधनज्ञातिबान्धवाः ॥

meaning.en: Scattering in different directions, leaving great fortune behind, we fled from fear of him with our wealth, kin and relatives.

verses.text:
इति संचिन्त्य सर्वे स्म प्रतीचीं दिशमाश्रिताः ।
कुशस्थलीं पुरीं रम्यां रैवतेनोपशोभिताम् ॥

meaning.en: Thinking so, we all took refuge in the western region, in the lovely city of Kushasthali, adorned by the mountain Raivata.

verses.text:
पुनर्निवेशनं तस्यां कृतवन्तो वयं नृप ।
तथैव दुर्गसंस्कारं देवैरपि दुरासदम् ॥

meaning.en: There, O king, we made a new settlement and fortified it so that even the gods could hardly assail it.

verses.text:
स्त्रियोऽपि यस्यां युध्येयुः किं पुनर्वृष्णिपुंगवाः ।
तस्यां वयममित्रघ्न निवसामोऽकुतोभयाः ॥

meaning.en: Even women could fight in that city, much more the bulls of the Vrishnis; in it, slayer of enemies, we live without fear from any quarter.

verses.text:
आलोक्य गिरिमुख्यं तं माधवीतीर्थमेव च ।
माधवाः कुरुशार्दूल परां मुदमवाप्नुवन् ॥

meaning.en: Seeing that chief of mountains and the holy ford of Madhavi, the Madhavas, tiger of the Kurus, felt supreme joy.

verses.text:
एवं वयं जरासंधादादितः कृतकिल्बिषाः ।
सामर्थ्यवन्तः संबन्धाद्भवन्तं समुपाश्रिताः ॥

meaning.en: So, though we had been wrongdoers to Jarasandha from the beginning, we, able though we are, have taken refuge in you because of our relation.

verses.text:
त्रियोजनायतं सद्म त्रिस्कन्धं योजनादधि ।
योजनान्ते शतद्वारं विक्रमक्रमतोरणम् ।
अष्टादशावरैर्नद्धं क्षत्रियैर्युद्धदुर्मदैः ॥

meaning.en: The mansion is three yojanas long, with three tiers rising above a yojana, with a hundred gates at its end, with towers of cunning design, and manned by eighteen lesser Kshatriya clans, fierce in war.

verses.text:
अष्टादश सहस्राणि व्रातानां सन्ति नः कुले ।
आहुकस्य शतं पुत्रा एकैकस्त्रिशतावरः ॥

meaning.en: In our clan there are eighteen thousand troops; Ahuka has a hundred sons, each with at least three hundred followers.

verses.text:
चारुदेष्णः सह भ्रात्रा चक्रदेवोऽथ सात्यकिः ।
अहं च रौहिणेयश्च साम्बः शौरिसमो युधि ॥

meaning.en: Charudeshna with his brother, Chakradeva, Satyaki, I myself, Rohini's son, and Samba, the equal of Shauri in battle:

verses.text:
एवमेते रथाः सप्त राजन्नन्यान्निबोध मे ।
कृतवर्मा अनाधृष्टिः समीकः समितिंजयः ॥

meaning.en: these are seven chariot-warriors, O king; hear now of others from me: Kritavarma, Anadhrishti, Samika, Samitinjaya,

verses.text:
कह्वः शङ्कुर्निदान्तश्च सप्तैवैते महारथाः ।
पुत्रौ चान्धकभोजस्य वृद्धो राजा च ते दश ॥

meaning.en: Kankva, Shanku and Nidanta; these seven are great chariot-warriors; and the two sons of Andhaka-Bhoja and the old king, making ten.

verses.text:
लोकसंहनना वीरा वीर्यवन्तो महाबलाः ।
स्मरन्तो मध्यमं देशं वृष्णिमध्ये गतव्यथाः ॥

meaning.en: They are heroes who hold the world together, mighty and strong, and, remembering the middle country, they live fearless among the Vrishnis.

verses.text:
स त्वं सम्राड्गुणैर्युक्तः सदा भरतसत्तम ।
क्षत्रे सम्राजमात्मानं कर्तुमर्हसि भारत ॥

meaning.en: You, ever endowed with the qualities of an emperor, best of the Bharatas, deserve to make yourself emperor among the Kshatriyas, Bharata.

verses.text:
न तु शक्यं जरासंधे जीवमाने महाबले ।
राजसूयस्त्वया प्राप्तुमेषा राजन्मतिर्मम ॥

meaning.en: But while the mighty Jarasandha lives, O king, you cannot obtain the Rajasuya; this is my thought.

verses.text:
तेन रुद्धा हि राजानः सर्वे जित्वा गिरिव्रजे ।
कन्दरायां गिरीन्द्रस्य सिंहेनेव महाद्विपाः ॥

meaning.en: By him all the kings, having been defeated, are held in Girivraja, in a cave of the king of mountains, like great elephants held by a lion.

verses.text:
सोऽपि राजा जरासंधो यियक्षुर्वसुधाधिपैः ।
आराध्य हि महादेवं निर्जितास्तेन पार्थिवाः ॥

meaning.en: King Jarasandha wished to sacrifice, and, having worshipped Mahadeva, he conquered the lords of the earth.

verses.text:
स हि निर्जित्य निर्जित्य पार्थिवान्पृतनागतान् ।
पुरमानीय बद्ध्वा च चकार पुरुषव्रजम् ॥

meaning.en: Having defeated the kings who had come with their armies again and again, he brought them to his city, bound them, and made a herd of men of them.

verses.text:
वयं चैव महाराज जरासंधभयात्तदा ।
मथुरां संपरित्यज्य गता द्वारवतीं पुरीम् ॥

meaning.en: And we too, great king, out of fear of Jarasandha, left Mathura then and went to the city of Dvaravati.

verses.text:
यदि त्वेनं महाराज यज्ञं प्राप्तुमिहेच्छसि ।
यतस्व तेषां मोक्षाय जरासंधवधाय च ॥

meaning.en: If you wish to obtain this sacrifice, great king, strive to free those kings and to kill Jarasandha.

verses.text:
समारम्भो हि शक्योऽयं नान्यथा कुरुनन्दन ।
राजसूयस्य कार्त्स्न्येन कर्तुं मतिमतां वर ॥

meaning.en: For this undertaking, delight of the Kurus, best of the wise, the Rajasuya cannot be completed in full any other way.

verses.text:
इत्येषा मे मती राजन्यथा वा मन्यसेऽनघ ।
एवं गते ममाचक्ष्व स्वयं निश्चित्य हेतुभिः ॥

meaning.en: This is my view, O king, or as you think best, blameless one; this being so, tell me yourself, after deciding it by reasons.
